description: This file defines the interface and data structures for managing a stack of reftables, including functions for creating, modifying, iterating, and compacting reftable stacks within a version control system. It provides operations for opening a new stack, adding tables, initializing iterators, and performing maintenance tasks like compaction and cleaning.

methods.name: reftable_new_stack
methods.description: Creates and opens a new reftable stack stored in the specified directory with optional write options.

methods.name: reftable_stack_next_update_index
methods.description: Returns the next update index for writing a new reftable to the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_new_addition
methods.description: Starts a new transaction to add reftables to the stack, locking the database.

methods.name: reftable_addition_add
methods.description: Adds a reftable to the current transaction with a user-provided write function.

methods.name: reftable_addition_commit
methods.description: Commits the current addition transaction, releasing the lock.

methods.name: reftable_addition_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the addition transaction, releasing resources and locks.

methods.name: reftable_stack_add
methods.description: Adds a new reftable to the stack via a write callback, optionally with specific flags.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse refs within the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse logs within the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_merged_table
methods.description: Retrieves the merged reftable for seeking, valid until the next write or reload.

methods.name: reftable_stack_destroy
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with the reftable stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_reload
methods.description: Reloads the stack if it is out of date.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compact_all
methods.description: Compresses all reftables into one giant table, optionally expiring reflog entries per configuration.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_required
methods.description: Checks if table compaction is necessary, using heuristics if specified.

methods.name: reftable_stack_auto_compact
methods.description: Heuristically performs table stack compaction.

methods.name: reftable_stack_clean
methods.description: Deletes stale reference tables.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_ref
methods.description: Reads a specific reference from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_log
methods.description: Reads a specific log record from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_stats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics about previous compactions.

methods.name: reftable_stack_hash_id
methods.description: Returns a hash identifier for the stack.

ctags.name: attempts
ctags.pattern: /^	int attempts; \/* how often we tried to compact *\/$/

ctags.name: bytes
ctags.pattern: /^	uint64_t bytes; \/* total number of bytes written *\/$/

ctags.name: entries_written
ctags.pattern: /^	uint64_t entries_written; \/* total number of entries written, including$/

ctags.name: failures
ctags.pattern: /^	int failures; \/* failures happen on concurrent updates *\/$/
